summary: Isolate named-instance native discovery and pi/omp profiles without changing HOME

schema.detail: No claim or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Named-instance native readers use a discovery-only root under the instance state directory, with aliases only to the instance Claude, Codex and shared pi/omp stores.

compatibility.detail: HOME remains the login HOME for drivers, hooks and shell tools. Named instances set PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR to their own pi/ directory, overriding an inherited profile path. The shared pi/omp native profile is exposed once as omp; distinct pi and omp saved-session labels within a named instance are out of scope. The default instance keeps its existing environment and discovery behavior.

downtime.detail: Restart an existing named instance daemon to use the isolated discovery root.

manual.detail: Before upgrading a named instance with omp agents, stop its agents and sign in to the instance pi/ profile, or explicitly migrate the required existing pi/omp login credentials and configuration to that directory before restarting. The upgrade does not copy the login-home profile, credentials or sessions. Existing Claude and Codex account directories are unchanged.

recovery.detail: No session files are copied, moved or deleted. An unexpected native-home alias is rejected rather than read.
